name: Permanent Residence -- Long-Term Work/Service Categories

requirements.blocker_text: Must serve as a Police or Prison Officer, or as a Teacher (government or charitable/religious institution), or as a Nurse (government or private healthcare facility).
Requires a minimum of 10 years' service in the qualifying occupation.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10 years in the qualifying occupation.

requirements.blocker_text: Must serve as a Minister of Religion/Priest, or as a Doctor/other medical professional.
Requires a minimum of 20 years' service in the qualifying occupation.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 20 years in the qualifying occupation.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 20 or more consecutive years of legal work permit status.
requirements.fix_path: Maintain continuous, unbroken work permit status for 20 years.

requirement_groups.name: Long-term residents on lower fee scales (10-20 years)

requirements.blocker_text: Applies to residents holding work permits under Immigration Fee Scales 5 through 8.
Requires 10 to 20 years of residency, with the exact figure depending on Fee Scale.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10-20 years of residency depending on Fee Scale.

requirement_groups.name: Children born abroad to a married Bahamian mother

requirements.blocker_text: Born legitimately abroad to a married Bahamian citizen mother and a non-citizen father -- this scenario does not qualify for automatic citizenship by descent (only children of UNMARRIED Bahamian mothers do), so PR is the route offered here; a separate citizenship registration route (Form IV, minors only) may also be available -- see bs_citizenship_by_registration_family.json.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying occupation and years of service, or work permit history

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Permanent Residence: government service professionals (10-year minimum: police/prison officers, teachers, nurses), religious/medical professionals (20-year minimum: ministers/priests, doctors), work permit holders (20+ consecutive years), long-term residents on Fee Scales 5-8 (10-20 years)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. Consolidates four distinct long-tenure eligibility categories from the same official PR page into one route with four OR-groups, since they share the same underlying Certificate of Permanent Residence outcome. The 'long_term_residents' group's exact year figure varies by Fee Scale (10-20 years) but the source does not give a scale-by-scale breakdown -- modelled at the 10-year floor as the earliest possible qualifying point, flagged as approximate. Children born abroad to a married Bahamian citizen mother with a non-citizen father are ALSO listed as a PR eligibility category on this same source, but are modelled separately in bs_citizenship_by_registration_family.json since that scenario more directly concerns a citizenship-adjacent family tie than a work/service tenure category.
